entities.summary: John Worrall is a British philosopher of science. He was a professor of philosophy of science at the London School of Economics until his retirement in 2019, when he became Emeritus Professor. He was also associated with the Centre for Philosophy of Natural and Social Science at the same institution. John Worrall was a philosophers & thinkers from Leigh (b. 1946-11-27, Leigh).
